name: The Belgravia Mansion
tagline: London's most magnificent Trophy home
description: Set on one of London's most prestigious addresses, Belgrave Square is the perfect example of Regency architecture, designed in 1824 as the focal point of the square. Overlooking the verdant gardens, the Grade I-listed house has an impressive double-fronted and stuccoed facade that sets the tone for what lies beyond. Spanning an expansive 30,941 square feet over seven floors, the building has eight principal bedrooms, five guest bedrooms and ancillary staff accommodation and has a well-appointed, thoughtfully designed interior that respects the property's history. Built by the celebrated architect George Basevi in 1824, the original features in the house have been meticulously preserved, making it a living piece of architectural history. When completed in the late 1820s, Belgrave Square quickly became one of London's most desirable addresses.

Meticulously restored, it features interior design by award-winning architect Peter Marino, which combines traditional grandeur with modern interventions. This grand residence features expansive formal entertaining areas with soaring ceilings of nearly 10ft. It also has a private cinema and a wood-panelled billiards room. The house also features a lift, mews house access and garaging. The courtyard garden is a tranquil retreat with plenty of space for entertaining alfresco.

name: St John's Wood House
tagline: Striking family home in the heart of St John's Wood
description: This striking stucco-fronted freehold house unfolds across five floors and measures 21,659.00 sq. ft. Set in the heart of St John's Wood, on the prestigious Avenue Road the property is beautifully defined by its exceptional finish, high ceilings, state-of-the-art technology and expansive living spaces. Interior design is by the internationally renowned David Linley and is characterised by its Art Deco finish that incorporates mahogany and teak joinery, antique brass ironmongery, and stunning finishes, including marble, onyx, and limestone bathrooms throughout. Upon entry, the marble-lined entrance lobby leads to a grand reception hall, featuring towering columns, a coffered ceiling, and a dramatic three-story lightwell crowned by a glazed dome. The principal reception room stretches the entire width of the house, with distinct areas for dining and seating, complemented by marble fireplaces, and French windows that open onto the beautifully landscaped large rear garden. The flamed-mahogany panelled study is complete with bookshelves and a marble fireplace and is the perfect retreat.

The bespoke family kitchen, with its marble floors and granite breakfast bar seating up to eight, has top-of-the-line Subzero appliances. A second fully-fitted professional-grade catering kitchen comes complete with a dumb waiter, perfect for entertaining on a large scale. The leisure and entertainment complex is nothing short of exceptional. It includes a teak-paneled games room with a snooker table, a media/cinema room with teak walls and columns, a star-lit ceiling, and a drinks bar. There's also a temperature-controlled wine cellar and for the active, a gym with a ballet rail. A steam room, sauna and plunge pool are paired with a drench shower. Additional facilities include two separate changing rooms as well as a hairdressing salon.

name: Knightsbridge Garden Residence
tagline: A once-in-a-generation trophy home in Knightsbridge
description: This refined retreat honours the provenance of its metropolitan postcode. Set in a handsome redbrick mansion block of just five residences, the apartment represents an opportunity to own a turnkey home in a prestigious neighbourhood with over 11,000 sq ft of living space. The property is a design-led quadruplex masterminded by renowned developer Finchatton and finished by leading superyacht design studio RWD. Entering on the ground floor, the calibre of materials and craftsmanship is apparent. A dual-aspect reception room sets the tone, with parquet flooring, elegant wainscoting and a stone fireplace. Also on this floor, a contemporary kitchen is designed as a staff facility. A grand staircase threads its way between all levels, each also benefiting from lift access. The first floor is designed for family living. Dual double doors grant access to a grand reception and dining room. Two south-facing bay windows frame verdant views of Hans Place and draw in daylight to illuminate refined details. Chevron flooring, voluminous proportions and a white marble fireplace characterise the room. A first-floor informal reception room balances the functions of cooking, dining and relaxing. Complete with a breakfast bar, a marble waterfall island characterises the kitchen. Hardwood flooring sweeps through a generous dining area into a convivial reception space.

The principal bedroom is of hotel suite proportions. The room is defined by a bank of French doors, a considered living area and a bathroom with a freestanding bath. Two further bedrooms occupy the first floor, as well as a leafy terrace. Across several rooms, 15 Juliet balconies invite natural light into this level. Three further bedroom suites are arranged over the ground and lower ground floors. Below, the home's basement level draws together an arsenal of amenities including a cinema, games room and wine cellar. The apartment also enjoys distinguished study spaces and a chef's kitchen. The apartment features comfort cooling, underfloor heating and a Lutron HomeWorks lighting system as well as bespoke joinery throughout. Ideal for a family with staff, all bedrooms have en suite bathrooms and all but one incorporate walk-in wardrobes. Remodelled by Finchatton, the building is fewer than 10 years old. Residents' amenities include a world-class gym, 24-hour concierge and a commercial kitchen available upon request. The property benefits from four parking spaces and enviable access to the gated garden of Hans Place. Beyond, Knightsbridge is an esteemed neighbourhood grounded by period architecture that sits only 15 miles from Heathrow Airport. Closer to home, Harrods and Harvey Nichols are within a three-minute walk. Michelin-starred restaurants Amaya, Pétrus by Gordon Ramsay and Dinner by Heston Blumenthal are also all within a 10-minute stroll, as are the lawns and lakes of Hyde Park.

name: Palais du Seizième
tagline: A Belle Époque Parisian Palace in the Heart of the 16th
description: Paris 16th – Victor Hugo / Exceptional 2,000 sqm Property with Private Garden, Terrace and Wellness Facilities. In the heart of the highly sought-after Victor Hugo neighborhood, in Paris's prestigious 16th arrondissement, this remarkable 2,000 sqm property offers an exceptional living environment, combining architectural elegance, generous proportions and high-end amenities. Offering complete privacy and unobstructed views, this outstanding residence features a magnificent 350 sqm private garden and a terrace, creating a peaceful retreat in the heart of the capital. These exceptional outdoor spaces provide the perfect setting for relaxation, entertaining and enjoying the Parisian lifestyle in complete discretion. The interiors are distinguished by their impressive volumes, abundant natural light and refined finishes. Elegant period features, including decorative moldings and a fireplace, enhance the property's timeless character, while contemporary amenities ensure the highest standards of comfort. The residence offers expansive reception areas, including an elegant living room and a spacious lounge, perfectly suited to both family life and sophisticated entertaining. A fully dedicated office space and a kitchen complete the living areas, providing a harmonious balance between functionality and refinement. The sleeping quarters comprise four beautifully appointed bedroom suites, each offering privacy and comfort.

The property also features six bathrooms and two shower rooms, ensuring exceptional convenience for residents and guests alike. Designed to provide an exclusive lifestyle, the residence includes an impressive private wellness area. A fully equipped fitness room, a hammam and a jacuzzi create an exceptional environment dedicated to relaxation and well-being, allowing residents to enjoy spa-like facilities in the comfort of their own home. Additional features include air conditioning, a reinforced security door and a water softening system, further enhancing the property's comfort, security and practicality. Its prime location represents another significant advantage. Ideally situated close to beautiful gardens, prestigious shopping streets and excellent transport connections, the property benefits from a RER station approximately 120 meters away and a metro station just 240 meters away. This privileged address offers convenient access to the very best of Paris while preserving a rare sense of tranquility and privacy. Presented in excellent condition, this exceptional residence stands out for its outstanding proportions, remarkable natural light, refined architectural details and extensive private outdoor spaces. A truly exceptional property in the heart of Victor Hugo, offering a rare combination of Parisian elegance, contemporary luxury and an exclusive lifestyle in one of the capital's most prestigious residential neighborhoods.

name: Villa Pampelonne
tagline: Luxury villa facing the sea – Les Parcs de Saint-Tropez
description: Nestled in the heart of a prestigious and secure estate, this magnificent property enjoys direct private access to the sea, spread over a 6573 sqm plot surrounded by majestic parasol pines. Built in 2014 by a renowned architect from Saint-Tropez, in a neo-Provençal style, it charms with its refined elegance, typical of South of France villas. Ideally located in a privileged area of Les Parcs, it offers breathtaking views of the bay of St-Tropez and the stunning Massif des Maures. This approximately 500 sqm property consists of six en-suite bedrooms, including the master en suite bedroom facing the sea; the fully equipped independent kitchen also has access to a professional kitchen. For your well-being, a dedicated wellness area awaits you, including a shower, spa, hammam, sauna and massage room. A wine cellar and a laundry room complete the practical amenities of the property.

Surrounded by lush green lawns and Mediterranean flora, the villa opens up to a spacious teak terrace and a sumptuous swimming pool. A portion of the grounds is transformed into a magnificent terrace by the water's edge, offering you privileged access to the sea. Following the recent modification of the Local Urban Plan (PLU), a building permit will soon be filed, allowing for the extension of approximately 56 sqm (+ 28 sqm in the basement). This extension could be used, for example, to create accommodations for staff. It will be discreetly integrated at the rear of the existing residence, preserving the privacy and harmony of the whole. A garage and several parking spaces complete this superb seaside property, a rare opportunity presented by Côte d'Azur Sotheby's International Realty, the luxury real estate agency based in Saint-Tropez.

name: Villa Son Vida Mirador
tagline: Mediterranean villa with sea views in Sol de Mallorca
description: Housing located in a consolidated coastal area of Mallorca, with sea views and direct access to a cove. Built in 2002 and maintained in excellent condition, the property reflects a marked Mediterranean style with solid and well-balanced architecture. It has approximately 1,780 m² built, distributed in seven generously sized bedrooms and nine bathrooms, designed to ensure comfort and functionality. Several rooms incorporate wellness areas such as a jacuzzi, sauna, and steam bath, reinforcing the high-level residential character.

The large windows allow a constant influx of natural light and offer panoramic views of the maritime surroundings. The interior spaces combine quality materials, such as marble floors, with areas dedicated to leisure and daily use, including a private gym, a cellar, and a bar area. The kitchen, fully equipped with modern appliances and a central island, is designed for both practical use and enjoying the views of the bay on a daily basis. Outside, the property has a carefully maintained private garden, large terraces, a pool, and direct access to the sea, as well as a closed garage for two vehicles and storage areas. Sol de Mallorca is one of the most valued residential areas in the southwest of the island, characterized by its tranquility, privacy, and natural environment, with crystal-clear coves, proximity to international schools, golf courses, medical services, and excellent connections to Palma and the airport.

name: Cap Martinet Seafront Estate
tagline: Exclusive Seafront Property in Ibiza
description: Absolutely unique property located on the seafront in Cap Martinet, with direct access to a cove and panoramic views of the Mediterranean and Formentera. This exceptional property consists of two plots: a modern villa already built on the cliff edge, with a tourist license, and a large rustic estate with an approved license to restore a historic ruin. All in an irreplaceable location that guarantees total privacy, nature, and proximity to the best areas of Ibiza. The first plot is a rustic land of 66,457 m² that has an approved project. It allows the construction of a house between 190 m² to 260 m², as it includes a ruin of 207 m² with barns, outbuildings, ancillary rooms, cistern, oven, and 19th century fireplace, renovated in 1955. It has an authorized perimeter enclosure, with fencing and boundary demarcation, offering completely restricted access. It includes three approved accesses: two electric gates and an additional gate that connects directly to the beach. This plot is the foundation of the Cap Martinet Project with direct access to the sea and offers the opportunity to develop a luxury private property in one of the most exclusive environments in Ibiza, representing an exceptional opportunity for investors and developers.

The second plot houses the modern villa, with a plot of 2,000 m² and approximately 280 m² built. It is a contemporary villa located on the cliff edge, completely renovated and with unobstructed frontal views of Formentera. It has five spacious bedrooms, a private cove just 50 meters away, pool, large terraces with stunning views, Sonos sound system, alarm system, air conditioning throughout the house, and covered electric parking. It also has a separate guest room with a private entrance and en-suite bathroom. The interior features a modern, bright, and functional design, with an open living room, fully equipped kitchen, and large sliding windows that connect directly to the outdoor areas. Cap Martinet is one of the most exclusive enclaves in Ibiza, known for its unparalleled views, natural surroundings, and proximity to the island's most iconic locations. Nearby points of interest include Talamanca Beach 5 minutes away, Marina Botafoch 5 minutes away, and the city of Ibiza 7 minutes away, as well as multiple coves and protected natural areas. The Cap Martinet Project represents a unique investment opportunity in Ibiza. Its privileged position on the seafront, private access to the Mediterranean, the extension of the rustic estate with an approved license, and the modern villa located on the cliff make it one of the most exceptional options in the luxury real estate market in the Balearic Islands.

name: Villa Ortensia
tagline: Villa Ortensia – timeless elegance on the shores of Lake Como
description: In the heart of Laglio, directly overlooking the waters of Lake Como, Villa Ortensia is a residence of rare beauty, nestled within approximately 5,000 sqm of historic parkland, where centuries-old trees, precious botanical species and exquisite flowering plants create a landscape of exceptional charm, gently extending all the way to the lakeshore. The origins of the villa and its gardens date back centuries: already documented in the Teresian Land Registry of 1721, they tell a story of elegance and prestige that has endured through time, preserving the property's distinctive character. The main villa, having undergone a meticulous restoration and now ready to move into, harmoniously combines the charm of historic architecture with contemporary comfort. Its interiors preserve architectural and decorative features of exceptional value, including an exquisite 18th-century marble fireplace, traditional terrazzo floors, an elegant Neoclassical colonnade and magnificent frescoed vaulted ceilings. The sleeping quarters comprise five double bedrooms, enhanced by delightful views of the lake and gardens, while the attic floor offers additional spaces suitable for accommodating guests, as well as dedicated staff quarters. Nestled in the greenery and perfectly integrated into the surrounding parkland, an independent guesthouse, complete with its own private swimming pool, welcomes guests into an atmosphere of absolute tranquillity and privacy.

Yet it is through its privileged connection with the lake that Villa Ortensia reveals one of its most extraordinary features. A direct, private and sheltered access leads to the waterfront area, where the private jetty and the historic boathouse, dating back to 1928, are located. The boathouse has now been transformed into an exclusive pieds-dans-l'eau retreat. This unique space, thoughtfully arranged with a combined living and sleeping area, kitchenette and bathroom, offers an exceptional setting where the interiors blend seamlessly with the presence of the water and the enchanting atmosphere of the private boat mooring. Above the boathouse, a spacious sun terrace opens onto the breathtaking panorama of Lake Como, offering a truly captivating setting where natural light, spectacular scenery and the immediate proximity of the water create an experience of absolute privilege. Villa Ortensia is far more than a prestigious residence: it is a place to be experienced, capable of evoking emotions that words alone can scarcely convey. Only by exploring its interiors, strolling through its magnificent parkland and discovering the extraordinary intimacy of its relationship with the lake can one fully appreciate what makes this property truly unique.

name: Palazzo Fiesolano
tagline: Prestigious historic residence set in a magnificent park
address: Via San Felice a Ema, Florence
description: Prestigious historic residence immersed in a magnificent centuries-old park, just a short distance from the historic center of Florence. An authentic period property that combines the charm of history with the elegance of architecture in a unique setting of prestige and privacy. The villa is nestled among the hills and tells a fascinating story of history, art, and power, bearing witness to centuries of Florentine glory. Once a fortified tower and stronghold of the noble Canigiani family, the building has passed through our history, including the Battle of Montaperti in 1260, which led to the family's exile by the Ghibellines. The political downfall of the Canigiani house marked the beginning of a much more enduring legacy with the 1306 union between Diletta Canigiani and the notary Petracco, who fathered Francesco Petrarca — poet, writer, and humanist — considered one of the fathers of the Italian language and a central figure of early Humanism, celebrated alongside Dante and Boccaccio. Over the centuries, the property became home to important Florentine families, such as the Dell'Antella, treasurers to the Medici, who transformed it into an elegant country residence. Later architectural interventions left visible traces: today, the villa is a perfect balance between 14th-century simplicity and 16th-century richness, with unique features such as a barrel-vaulted loggia, a panoramic terrace, and a chapel frescoed in the style of Poccetti. After a careful restoration in the 1970s, this historic home has returned to its most authentic form, preserving the original charm intact. Surrounded by about 7 hectares of private parkland with manicured gardens, tree-lined avenues, and a vast forest, it offers a setting of complete privacy and prestige just minutes from Florence.

The main villa, ideal for those seeking a residence rich in history and Tuscan charm, is laid out over several levels and stands out for its architectural grandeur, with 33 rooms, including: a grand entrance hall, three living rooms with coffered ceilings and fireplaces, a large dining room with fireplace and large windows overlooking the park, a sitting room, a second entrance with library, three en suite double bedrooms with walk-in closets, a main kitchen with service entrances, and a guest bathroom. The lower level features a large library fitted with technical shelving and a charming billiard room with direct garden access. A double bedroom with en suite bathroom is found on the mezzanine level. The first floor houses staff quarters and utility rooms. Within the villa's courtyard and loggia is the family chapel, dedicated to Saint Francis and decorated in the 1600s in the style of Poccetti, symbolizing the elegance typical of historic homes of the time. Also located here is Diletta Canigiani's historic bridal chamber, adorned with splendid period frescoes. On the loggia level are two residential units, ideal for guests or as a private study. The surrounding park features a stunning swimming pool with dining and barbecue area, a tennis court set in greenery, a guest house, and ample space that allows for the addition of a helipad for fast and exclusive connections. Completing the property are additional residences of various sizes and numerous service buildings: a garage adjacent to the villa, lemon house, storage facilities, technical rooms, cellars, pantries, laundry and ironing rooms, and several driveways ensuring privacy and independence between the different units. A timeless residence offering the privilege of living a chapter of Tuscan history, characterized by elegance, privacy, and the exclusive greenery of the Florentine hills.

name: Esperos Estate
tagline: Esperos Estate – 52,000 m² on Corfu's west coast
description: On Corfu's western coastline, where the landscape opens towards uninterrupted views of the Ionian Sea, Esperos Estate occupies approximately 52,000 square metres of private land. Its position overlooking the Ionian Sea offers magnificent sunset views, while the scale of the grounds creates an exceptional sense of privacy and seclusion. Approximately 1,050 square metres of built space are distributed across the main residence and a collection of independent buildings discreetly positioned throughout the grounds. These provide private guest accommodation, dedicated staff quarters, office and wellness facilities, as well as a charming house beside the beach. With 15 bedrooms and 18 bathrooms in total, the estate offers exceptional flexibility for hosting family and guests. The main house features spacious living and dining areas, a library, private office and cinema room. A fully equipped kitchen, together with a separate professional kitchen, caters equally well to everyday living and entertaining. The house includes a master suite and two en-suite guest bedrooms, with an approximately 81-square-metre heated swimming pool providing a natural focus for outdoor living.

A four-bedroom staff house and separate housekeeper's accommodation support the smooth and discreet operation of the estate. At the water's edge, a secluded beach, private jetty and wooden sunbathing platform offer direct access to the clear waters of the Ionian Sea. Despite its secluded setting, Esperos Estate remains within easy reach of Corfu Town and the island's international airport, combining privacy with convenient access. With its remarkable scale, sunset views and direct access to the Ionian Sea, Esperos brings together privacy, space and an exceptional coastal setting.

name: Le Paradis
tagline: Le Paradis – Estate Catherineberg
description: Set amidst thousands of acres of protected Virgin Islands National Parklands, Le Paradis stands as a rare sanctuary of unrivaled privacy, architectural distinction, and refined island luxury. Designed by a world-renowned team of designers led by Tony Ingrao of Ingrao, Inc. and Mario Nievera of Nievera Williams Landscape Architecture in partnership with Kevin Qualls of US Virgin Islands-based Springline Architects, this architectural triumph is a recently rebuilt tapestry of exquisitely curated spaces interwoven throughout a sprawling tropical oasis. Offering panoramic views of St. John's iconic north shore as the central feature of an expansive 16,000 sq ft indoor-outdoor living experience, Le Paradis is a retreat of exceptional comfort, craftsmanship, and sophistication. Designed to serve as a self-contained, full-service luxury retreat, Le Paradis offers a guest experience rivaling that of the world's most revered five-star resorts. The estate features six elegantly appointed guest suites, each with spa-like en-suite baths and breathtaking views of the surrounding seascape, along with expansive indoor and outdoor lounging spaces offering intimate relaxation or grand scale entertaining. A state-of-the-art home theater brings cinematic luxury to the heart of the home, while the private wellness center, complete with commercial-grade spa facilities, a fitness suite, and dedicated areas for meditation and rejuvenation, elevates the experience of tranquil indulgence. A testament to masterful craftsmanship and painstaking attention to detail, Le Paradis was meticulously designed to integrate seamlessly with its natural surroundings while embodying an uncompromised level of comfort and luxury.

The villa's architectural language is a refined blend of classic Caribbean vernacular and contemporary luxury. Hand-selected materials including locally sourced stone, marble quarried from Italy, custom polished sycamore cabinetry designed by St Charles Kitchens, and exquisite fixtures throughout from THG and Gessi enhance the estate's aesthetic appeal, while floor-to-ceiling glass frames dramatic views of the surrounding seascapes from every room. The estate also includes two large executive offices designed for a healthy work-life balance, as well as dedicated staff accommodations to ensure effortless hospitality while maintaining absolute privacy. Le Paradis is one of the few residences on St. John to feature a private elevator, quietly connecting every level of this remarkable home with ease. The landscape architecture features a meticulously curated selection of specimen trees, colorful flora and professionally designed lighting. Notwithstanding its ultra-private locale, the estate is just a short walk from the palm-fringed white sand of Cinnamon Bay beach and mere minutes from the vibrance and convenience of nearby Cruz Bay. Beyond its stunning design and world-class amenities, Le Paradis is built to an uncompromising standard of quality and durability. Equipped with cutting-edge technology, including Savant home automation, fully integrated Lutron lighting, and a state-of-the-art home theater with studio-quality projection, acoustics, and seating, the estate is both intuitively functional and impeccably refined.

The architecture draws from the distinguished neo-classical style of the British West Indies — measured, symmetrical, and enduring — creating a thoughtfully composed layout with classical proportions. Generous ceiling heights and long internal sightlines orient the house naturally toward uninterrupted sea views, while indoor and outdoor spaces connect seamlessly, allowing the ocean to remain the constant focal point. Natural Caribbean limestone and coral stone define the exterior. This dual-kitchen configuration allows the home to operate equally well as a private family retreat or as a setting for elegant entertaining. The seven ensuite bedrooms are arranged to provide privacy and independence, many with direct access to terraces and open water views.

Two additional staff bedrooms, located within a separate cottage, allow for full-service living while preserving the privacy of the main residence. An elevated infinity-edge pool and jacuzzi overlook the shoreline. An oceanfront pavilion sits above one of the finest stretches of beach on New Providence, while multiple seating and dining areas are integrated into mature tropical landscaping with direct access to the sand and calm turquoise waters. A dedicated gym building further supports a self-contained, long-term residential lifestyle. The villa features 17 individually controlled air-conditioning zones and a Control4 smart home system providing seamless control of lighting, climate, entertainment, and security throughout the residence. name: Hacienda Santa Inés
tagline: Hacienda Santa Inés – a 1580 estate of waterfalls and lakes
description: Located in Cuautla, Morelos, Mexico, a true historical jewel that dates back to the year 1580. With a total area of one hundred and eighteen thousand square meters, including an 8-hectare plot of land currently covered with a cane field and apantles. Founded by Diego Caballero, who established it after receiving land as a royal donation, the Hacienda has a rich history linked to figures such as El Niño Artillero, Narciso Mendoza and General José María Morelos y Pavón, who is said to have escaped through its tunnels during the siege of Cuautla. Today, Hacienda Santa Inés is a spectacular place where water is the main protagonist, with waterfalls, lakes, wells, aqueducts, apantles and cisterns that adorn its ancient and beautiful gardens. The imposing main hull offers panoramic views of a waterfall that flows into a tranquil lake. It also has 14 magnificent luxury rooms, which offer their guests beautiful views from their balconies and the sound of nature. The Hacienda has several spaces for sports facilities such as a professional soccer field, sometimes used as a helipad, tennis courts, racquetball and basketball, an impressive indoor pool, and more.

The chapel is beautiful; next to it is the El Laurel garden and the sculpture garden. The 58-meter-high chacuaco (chimney) has an internal staircase for those who like to climb to enjoy the imposing view of the place. In addition to being a dream location for weddings and social events, the hacienda has an authorized Foundation Grantee, valid in the United States, which makes it a destination of international interest. With security guarded by armed police since 1980, the hacienda also has permits for various uses, from hotels to rehabilitation centers, as well as a certificate of infeasibility issued by the government. It also includes sculptures, machinery and an industrial kitchen, with the possibility of expanding into a housing development or shopping center on the adjacent 8-hectare land. This property has been valued by a certified National Monuments appraiser. Hacienda Santa Inés is a true historical and commercial treasure in the City of Cuautla.

name: Cedar Cliff
tagline: Cedar Cliff – gated peninsula on Long Island Sound
description: Perched in timeless elegance atop an expansive 2.91-acre gated peninsula, with best-in-class views of the Manhattan skyline and the shimmering Long Island Sound, Cedar Cliff is a Mediterranean villa of unrivaled pedigree and commanding presence. Privately situated along a secluded road within Riverside's prestigious Indian Head Association, this storied property occupies the historic grounds of railroad magnate Henry Francis Shoemaker's former compound — a Gilded Age legacy that later served as the backdrop for the iconic Cedar Cliff Beach Club of the 1920s. The estate bears the name Shoemaker originally gave his villa, 'Cedar Cliff' — a designation that eventually defined the very road on which it stands today. Elevated high above the flood zone and offering 1,250 +/- feet of direct water frontage, the property unfolds with extraordinary scale and privacy. A sweeping, manicured lawn rolls gracefully toward the shoreline, creating a striking foreground to the panoramic coastal vistas and an exceptional setting for grand-scale entertaining. Each of the eight oversized bedrooms is oriented to capture breathtaking water views, while interiors blend the romance of pre-war craftsmanship with modern refinement — soaring ceilings, intricate millwork, antique wood floors, a three-level elevator and a professional recording studio. The East Wing, constructed in the early 2000s, introduces a new dimension of contemporary luxury, anchored by a sophisticated primary suite and complemented by a custom office, wine cellar, and private theater capable of accommodating up to twenty guests.

The grounds rival those of a world-class private resort. A substantial stone pier and deep-water dock provide immediate access to open water, while a seaside tennis court with pergola and lighting offers championship-level play. At the water's edge, a pool and spa are paired with a fully realized cabana featuring a fitness center, kitchenette, full bathroom and changing rooms. Sculpted into the eastern landscape, a series of stone terraces with a bluestone bar directly overlook Greenwich Cove and the vast protected expanse of Greenwich Point Park. Meticulously maintained and thoughtfully enhanced, the estate includes a newly installed Ludowici terra cotta roof, rebuilt sun decks, custom East Wing windows, and a full-property generator. With access to a private beach and watercraft facilities, and located less than an hour from Manhattan and minutes from Westchester County Airport, the property offers a rare convergence of seclusion, scale, and global accessibility. Cedar Cliff is a singular offering for the most discerning buyer — an incomparable experience of refined luxury on one of the finest estates on the East Coast of the United States.

name: Briar Patch
tagline: Briar Patch – 100 & 90 Briar Patch Road, Georgica Pond
description: Commanding nearly a quarter-mile of pristine frontage on Georgica Pond, 100 & 90 Briar Patch is one of East Hampton's most extraordinary waterfront estates. Encompassing two contiguous parcels across 11.2+/- acres, this rare compound offers an unparalleled level of privacy, scale, and natural beauty, complemented by approximately 13,800+/- square feet of exquisitely curated living space. Positioned to capture sweeping southwestern views, the estate enjoys breathtaking sunsets over Georgica Pond, with the Atlantic Ocean shimmering on the horizon beyond. A property of exceptional pedigree and provenance, Briar Patch presents a once-in-a-generation opportunity to own a landmark East Hampton retreat where history, architecture, and setting converge in perfect harmony. The main residence, originally constructed in 1931, is a masterful expression of timeless elegance and architectural distinction. Designed for grand-scale entertaining and sophisticated living, the home encompasses six bedrooms, eight full baths, and two powder rooms, along with an array of expansive gathering spaces. Rich in character and craftsmanship, the interiors seamlessly blend old-world charm with refined contemporary comforts. French doors throughout the residence open to expansive terraces and outdoor entertaining areas. Set on a separate 3.7+/- acre parcel, the guest house was designed by renowned architect Peter Marino and completed in 1990.

Both modern and enduring in its design, this exceptional residence offers four ensuite bedrooms, four full baths, and a powder room. Coffered ceilings, a fireplace, and beautifully proportioned living spaces create an atmosphere of understated luxury, while a full kitchen and private accommodations provide the ultimate retreat for family and guests. Between the two residences, a heated gunite pool and spa serve as the centerpiece of the compound's resort-like amenities. Meandering nature trails wind through mature specimen trees and lush natural landscaping, leading to a secluded private pond. From the property's shoreline, residents can sail, paddleboard, or kayak across Georgica Pond directly to the ocean. Originally commissioned by Arthur C. Jackson, the main residence was designed by the celebrated architect behind the plans for the New York Public Library and Lasata, the childhood home of Jacqueline Kennedy Onassis. In 1990, Peter Marino further elevated the estate, thoughtfully enhancing the main residence while introducing the guest house. Ideally situated south of the highway on coveted Briar Patch Road, the estate is moments from East Hampton's celebrated ocean beaches, fine dining, and luxury boutiques, accessible by car or boat. 100 & 90 Briar Patch stands as one of the Hamptons' most distinguished private estates — a legacy property of enduring significance.

name: 15 East 96th Street
tagline: 15 East 96th Street – Gilded Age limestone mansion
description: A rare Gilded Age limestone mansion at 15 East 96th Street, built in 1915 for Lucy Drexel Dahlgren by architect Ogden Codman Jr., later refined by Pierre Cartier. Meticulously upgraded in 2004 by David Easton, Andre Tchelistcheff Architects, and Xhema Construction, the residence blends museum-quality craftsmanship with modern infrastructure. Built in the Neo-French Classic style, the mansion reflects early 20th-century opulence. This 37'6"-wide by 101'-deep Beaux Arts limestone townhouse rises five stories in front and six in the rear, offering 18,570 sq ft gross, 14,800 sq ft above grade, plus 3,237 sq ft of outdoor space. The home has an interior elevator from the lower level to the fifth floor and 11 fireplaces with marble mantles. A secure gated entry leads to a heated cobblestone driveway and a double-height turntable lift garage. Additional air rights are available. First floor: a private limestone entry opens to a grand stair hall with 11'8" ceilings, marble floors, carved staircase, elevator, and powder room. The south-facing reception room features oak boiserie, fireplace, and French doors. An octagonal paneled salon faces south, north, and west. Parlor floor: a sweeping marble stair rises to a landing beneath 15'6" ceilings.

The 35' x 20.5' living room offers three French window doors, Versailles floors, and a marble fireplace. The octagonal dining room includes terrazzo floors and carved Italian marble fountains. A professional pantry and chef's kitchen (Sub-Zero, Wolf, Gaggenau, Miele) complete the floor, with a rear staff apartment above the kitchen. Third floor: the primary suite spans the south side with paneled walls, French windows, a fireplace, and antique mirrors. Two marble bathrooms offer steam showers, a Jacuzzi, closets, and dressing rooms; a northwest media room and a guest suite complete the floor. Fourth floor: a secondary primary suite includes two fireplaces, two marble baths, a sitting room, and closets beneath arched ceilings. A Louis XIV-style library faces west. Fifth floor: a 35' x 16' planted terrace with pergola and fireplace enjoys southern views. An octagonal solarium with a skylight and a fireplace opens onto the terrace. Sixth floor: a bedroom, tiled bath, and west-facing terrace crown the home. Lower level: with 11'4" ceilings, the basement includes storage, cedar closets, laundry, wine storage, mechanical rooms, security suite, and space ideal for a gym, spa, pool, or media room, with access to the lower level of the garage. A once-in-a-lifetime offering: an intact, landmarked Gilded Age limestone mansion with exceptional privacy, security, and a rare, oversized double-height garage.

name: Menemsha Pond Estate
tagline: Contemporary waterfront estate on Menemsha Pond
description: A rare offering on the shores of Menemsha Pond, this extraordinary contemporary waterfront estate redefines luxury living in Chilmark. Thoughtfully designed with striking modern architecture, walls of glass, and seamless indoor-outdoor living, this one-of-a-kind compound captures breathtaking water views from nearly every room. Set on 4.9 acres with a private 115-foot deep-water dock, the property represents an irreplaceable opportunity, as a waterfront estate of this scale and caliber could no longer be replicated today. The main residence features six luxurious ensuite bedrooms, including a spectacular first-floor primary suite with dual spa-inspired bathrooms. Two state-of-the-art kitchens appointed with top-tier appliances provide exceptional spaces for entertaining, while the dramatic main living area showcases soaring cathedral ceilings and panoramic pond views. A screened porch and expansive waterfront deck create effortless transitions between interior and exterior living spaces. Upstairs, a striking glass-lined hallway with a dramatic glass floor overlooks the water, leading to guest suites with private baths and access to a second-floor deck.

Exceptional amenities include a private theater with massage seating, wine cellar, outdoor shower, and a hilltop writer's cottage with sweeping water views. Set just beyond the main house is the pool house: a private wellness retreat featuring a heated indoor pool, spa, sauna, cold plunge, steam room, wet bar, and spacious enclosed porch surrounded by retractable glass doors. The second floor includes a full guest suite with a bedroom, living room, laundry, and dual balconies overlooking Menemsha Pond. The estate also includes an impressive 1,927 sq ft barn-style entertainment pavilion. The upper level features a professionally designed fitness center with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the grounds and pond, alongside a sprawling recreation lounge with space for indoor basketball, billiards, ping pong, and additional sporting activities. Below, the structure houses an expansive six-car garage. Completing this incomparable estate are a private tennis court and charming boathouse by the dock for paddleboards and waterfront equipment. An unparalleled modern retreat in one of Martha's Vineyard's most exclusive waterfront settings.
